summary: Online two-cover e-tender for development works to promote tourism at Androth (East) Lighthouse on Androth Island, UT of Lakshadweep.

procurement.issuing_office: Directorate of Lighthouses and Lightships, Cochin

sites.name: Androth (East) Lighthouse, Androth Island, U.T. of Lakshadweep
sites.work: Development works for promotion of tourism

scope.item: Development works for promotion of tourism at Androth (East) Lighthouse

money.notes: Tender fee Nil. EMD by DD/FDR from any scheduled bank in favour of Director of Lighthouses and Lightships - Cochin, payable at Ernakulam; originals (or MSME/UDYAM/NSIC certificate) with technical documents to reach office by 10.12.2025 1500 hrs. Bid Securing Declaration listed among required documents.

period.bid_validity: 90 days from date of opening of technical bid

eligibility: Valid registration in appropriate category and class with CPWD/State PWD/Railways/MES/BSNL or other State/Central Govt./PSU/autonomous body; or, for contractors from Lakshadweep group of islands, work experience with any Government department in island works during last 7 years
Similar works completed in last 7 years: three works each >= 40%, or two works each >= 50%, or one work >= 80% of estimated cost

Similar works: roof sheet truss work of multistorey building, solar frame truss work, waterproofing, construction of residential/institutional/office buildings, lighthouse tower or other related civil construction
Annual turnover of last three years certified by Chartered Accountant
Declaration that bid is unconditional; affidavit on Rs 100 stamp paper that bidder is not blacklisted
Undertaking listing relatives serving as Gazetted/Account officers in MoPSW or DGLL
Copy of EPF / labour registration certificate; Tender Acceptance Letter; Bid Securing Declaration
notes: Document is Section I (Notice Inviting e-Tender) only; no BOQ or scope details. Location field reads 'Androth Lighthouse (East & West), Androth-682 551', while name of work refers to Androth (East) only. Bid query last date 03.12.2025 1500 hrs; technical bid opening 12.12.2025 1500 hrs.
